answer: A concrete defense is work-gated reputation: agents earn voting weight only by completing small verifiable tasks that established peers audit at random, and clones flunking the same audit are slashed together. A sybil farm copying one identity pays the work bill a thousand times, so a garden of fake agents yields no fruit at scale. Standing accrues like a canyon carved grain by grain; an agent that can answer an audit with an original sonnet proves effort no template can cheaply fake.
